overview.title: About OCRBC Scan
overview.subtitle: Official Municipal Technology Platform
overview.p1: OCRBC Scan is the official digital administration platform engineered for District One-Window Services (OWSU) and municipal civil status offices. Its primary mandate is to eliminate bureaucratic backlogs and expedite the accurate extraction and validation of civil registration documents, focusing on Birth Certificates (BC).
overview.p2: The system combines high-fidelity dual-script Khmer and Latin OCR artificial intelligence with an absolute Zero-Data-Retention (ZDR) baseline, guaranteeing citizen privacy and statutory compliance above all else.

goal.title: Core Goals
goal.subtitle: Measurable Operational Milestones
goal.desc: Eliminate error-prone manual typing and compress document verification cycles to under 1.8 seconds per civil certificate.
items: Accelerate public service delivery at municipal and commune administrative counters.
Maintain 99.4% extraction accuracy across Khmer administrative typography and certificate codes.
Prevent clerical spelling and date discrepancies through automated cross-referencing with municipal records.
Completely eliminate citizen identity leak vectors via pure in-memory execution (RAM Only).

vision.title: Strategic Vision
vision.subtitle: Long-term Strategic Direction
vision.desc: Serve as the foundational blueprint for smart, trustworthy digital governance in Cambodia, establishing uncompromised privacy and operational transparency.
items: Transition district civil status administration into modern, streamlined, paperless governance.
Foster public trust through cryptographically tamper-evident, verifiable civil records.
Elevate Khmer computational linguistics (Khmer NLP & OCR) to world-class government benchmarks.

mission.title: Platform Mission
mission.subtitle: Core Administrative Commitment
mission.desc: Empower civil registry officers with intuitive, robust AI-driven tools to verify documents instantaneously with complete statutory accuracy.
items: Deploy specialized OCR models fine-tuned on Cambodian administrative typefaces (Kantumruy Pro).
Enforce strict Zero-Data-Retention architecture, prohibiting image or identity caching on persistent storage.
Deliver an interactive bounding-box workspace enabling officers to inspect, audit, and approve records with human-in-the-loop oversight.

policies.title: Institutional Policies
policies.subtitle: Foundational Governance & Privacy Principles
policies.desc: Foundational governance principles ensuring public trust and citizen privacy:

items.name: Zero-Data-Retention Policy (ZDR Principle)
items.detail: Documents ingested into the system are never stored on persistent hard drives. Processing occurs strictly in volatile RAM to completely eradicate citizen identity data breach vectors.

items.name: Citizen Identity Privacy Protection Policy
items.detail: Personally Identifiable Information (PII) is never shared with third-party vendors or external cloud endpoints. All data cross-referencing occurs strictly within secure municipal boundaries.

items.name: Public Transparency & Accountability Policy
items.detail: Every extracted value and cross-reference outcome provides transparent confidence scoring directly to presiding administrative officers without obfuscation.

items.name: Cryptographic Integrity Policy
items.detail: Every verified document is stamped with a deterministic SHA-256 cryptographic audit fingerprint to certify authenticity and detect tampering.

rules.title: Operational Rules & Directives
rules.subtitle: Mandatory Technical Directives & Officer Instructions
rules.desc: Mandatory operational rules enforced for civil registry officers and system processes:

items.name: 1. Mandatory Review Rule for Scores Below 85%
items.detail: Any bounding box or extracted field scoring below 85% confidence mandates visual inspection and manual correction by the presiding officer before approval.

items.name: 2. Immediate Volatile Buffer Purge Rule (Crypto-Wipe)
items.detail: Upon verification completion, receipt export, or session termination, all transient document memory buffers are cryptographically zeroized in volatile RAM within 0 seconds.

items.name: 3. Permitted File Format & Size Rule
items.detail: The portal strictly accepts PNG, JPEG, WebP, and PDF files not exceeding 15 MB. Files outside these specifications are rejected by the pre-flight gate.

items.name: 4. Presiding Officer Authorization Rule
items.detail: OCR and machine learning models serve solely as efficiency accelerators. The designated One-Window Service officer retains full statutory responsibility for certifying civil records.
